Anthropic / AgentDojo / ControlArena
RESEARCH GIVES US A METHOD. NOT A WARRANTY.
Controlled pressure. Tool boundaries. Useful work alongside safety.
PRESSURE TESTS
Anthropic: constructed conflicts can expose concerning behavior.
TOOL-BOUNDARY TESTS
AgentDojo: test adversarial content through an agent's tools.
CONTROL EVALUATION
ControlArena: compare policy, monitoring and useful task completion.
A constructed failure shows possibility—not production prevalence.
